name: Grade 8 IIT Practice: August Week 13 - Cleanup
description: Practice words for Grade 8 second-trimester Arduino work.

words.definition: Putting materials or files back in order.
words.example: Cleanup returned the breadboard and jumper wires to the kit.

words.definition: A set of tools or parts.
words.example: The kit held the Arduino board, wires, and components.
Each component was counted before the group left.

words.definition: A saved document, image, or project on a computer.
words.example: The code file was saved before the computer was shut down.

words.definition: To store files neatly for later.
words.example: The student can archive the final sketch and screenshots.

words.definition: To put something back where it belongs.
words.example: The group can return the sensor to the correct box.
